import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Basic
import Mathlib.Order.Bounds.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic

open Nat

theorem rmo_2000_6 :
  (IsLeast {n | ∃ a b : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 2000 ∣ a ^ 2 * b ^ 5 ∧ n = a * b} 10) ∧

      · decide

      have hpos : 0 < a * b := mul_pos ha0 hb0

        have h2pow : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a ^ 2 * b ^ 5 := by
          have : (2 : ℕ) ∣ 2000 := by norm_num
          exact Nat.dvd_trans this hdiv
        rcases (Nat.prime_two.dvd_mul).1 h2pow with h2a | h2b
        · have h2a' : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a := (Nat.prime_two.dvd_pow).1 h2a
          exact Nat.dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h2a' b
        · have h2b' : (2 : ℕ) ∣ b := (Nat.prime_two.dvd_pow).1 h2b
          exact Nat.dvd_mul_of_dvd_right a h2b'
      -- 5 divides a*b

        have h5pow : (5 : ℕ) ∣ a ^ 2 * b ^ 5 := by
          have : (5 : ℕ) ∣ 2000 := by norm_num
          exact Nat.dvd_trans this hdiv
        rcases (Nat.prime_five.dvd_mul).1 h5pow with h5a | h5b
        · have h5a' : (5 : ℕ) ∣ a := (Nat.prime_five.dvd_pow).1 h5a
          exact Nat.dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h5a' b
        · have h5b' : (5 : ℕ) ∣ b := (Nat.prime_five.dvd_pow).1 h5b
          exact Nat.dvd_mul_of_dvd_right a h5b'
      -- 10 divides a*b
      have h10ab : (10 : ℕ) ∣ a * b := by
        have hcop : Coprime (2 : ℕ) (5 : ℕ) := by
          decide
        exact hcop.dvd_mul h2ab h5ab
      exact Nat.le_of_dvd hpos h10ab
  · -- second part
    refine ⟨?mem2, ?min2⟩
    · -- 20 belongs to the set
      refine ⟨1, 20, ?_, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
      · decide
      · decide
      · have : (2000 : ℕ) ∣ 20 ^ 4 := by
          norm_num
        simpa [pow_three] using this
    · -- minimality
      intro n hn
      rcases hn with ⟨a, b, ha0, hb0, hdiv, rfl⟩
      have hpos : 0 < a * b := mul_pos ha0 hb0
      -- 2 divides a*b
      have h2ab : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a * b := by
        have h2pow : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a ^ 3 * b ^ 4 := by
          have : (2 : ℕ) ∣ 2000 := by norm_num
          exact Nat.dvd_trans this hdiv
        rcases (Nat.prime_two.dvd_mul).1 h2pow with h2a | h2b
        · have h2a' : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a := (Nat.prime_two.dvd_pow).1 h2a
          exact Nat.dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h2a' b
        · have h2b' : (2 : ℕ) ∣ b := (Nat.prime_two.dvd_pow).1 h2b
          exact Nat.dvd_mul_of_dvd_right a h2b'
      -- 5 divides a*b
      have h5ab : (5 : ℕ) ∣ a * b := by
        have h5pow : (5 : ℕ) ∣ a ^ 3 * b ^ 4 := by
          have : (5 : ℕ) ∣ 2000 := by norm_num
          exact Nat.dvd_trans this hdiv
        rcases (Nat.prime_five.dvd_mul).1 h5pow with h5a | h5b
        · have h5a' : (5 : ℕ) ∣ a := (Nat.prime_five.dvd_pow).1 h5a
          exact Nat.dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h5a' b
        · have h5b' : (5 : ℕ) ∣ b := (Nat.prime_five.dvd_pow).1 h5b
          exact Nat.dvd_mul_of_dvd_right a h5b'
      -- 20 divides a*b
      have h20ab : (20 : ℕ) ∣ a * b := by
        have hcop : Coprime (2 : ℕ) (5 : ℕ) := by decide
        have h10ab : (10 : ℕ) ∣ a * b := hcop.dvd_mul h2ab h5ab
        rcases h10ab with ⟨k, hk⟩
        have : (2 : ℕ) ∣ k := by
          have : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a * b := h2ab
          have : (2 : ℕ) ∣ 10 * k := by simpa [hk] using this
          have h2_10 : (2 : ℕ) ∣ 10 := by norm_num
          exact (Nat.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left h2_10).1 this
        rcases this with ⟨m, hm⟩
        refine ⟨2 * m, ?_⟩
        simpa [hk, hm, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using rfl
      exact Nat.le_of_dvd hpos h20ab
